text: I'm testing five pages, and the careers page is done. The missions and Artemis III runs are still going. I'm queuing the last two pages now.

I tested all five pages, but many criteria are still NEEDS_REVIEW. Where a result is FAIL, the failing element is named in the RESULT line.

**What failed**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks:** careers, missions, Artemis III and KSC history have no way to skip the repeated header. The tool tried the "Explore", "News & Events" and "Multimedia" buttons, and none moved focus past the header. On the NACA page the tool only tried the first 8 possible skip methods, so I left it NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions:** on all five pages the header search box's only label is gray placeholder text that disappears when you type.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible:** two pages failed.
  - On Artemis III, the video "Hide player controls" button shows no change when it gets focus.
  - On the NACA page, the tool also flagged many elements, but I only have its summary of them, not the full list. I named the sticky-header links and the video player buttons as the failing elements, which is my reading of that summary.
- **2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide:** on the NACA page, small pulsing indicators move for more than 5 seconds with no pause control. I judged them decorative, not essential. A full-width moving area on that page (about every 0.44 s) was not resolved. I answered "unsure" on it because I did not look at its images.

**Why most results are NEEDS_REVIEW**
- **Focus order (2.4.3):** all five pages jump backwards in several places (footer link columns, card grids, video players). I could not settle whether that breaks the meaning, so I answered "unsure" everywhere.
- **Multiple Ways (2.4.5):** the tool found at most the site search and could not confirm a second way. Its follow-up runs with the home page and sitemap did not finish in the time available, so I did not use them.
- **Auto-updating content (2.2.2):** each page sets a long timer or polls its server, and the tool could only watch for 6.5 seconds. A person should watch each page for about a minute.
- **Keyboard (2.1.1):** Artemis III and NACA have embedded video frames the tool could not read.
- **Form labels (1.3.1 / 4.1.2, 2.4.6):** the frames also stopped these checks on those two pages. On careers, the tool could not read the text around six textboxes. On missions, only 60 of 101 fields were checked.
- **Missions page:** the 3.2.2, 3.3.1, 3.3.3 and 3.3.4 checks did not finish. The page has 98 form fields, and the follow-up run for 3.2.2 was still queued when I stopped.
- **Careers focus visibility (2.4.7):** about 8 elements, including the "Learn More" links, had no usable before-and-after view. They need a person to check.

**Passes and DNA**
- **Consistent Navigation (3.2.3):** all five pages pass.
- **Consistent Identification (3.2.4):** all five pass, after I judged the section sub-menu buttons (Featured Careers, Artemis and so on) to be different controls, not inconsistent names.
- **Audio Control (1.4.2):** does not apply on any page. No audio played by itself.
- **Search form:** the only form on most pages is the site search, which accepts any input and showed no errors. So error identification (3.3.1), error suggestion (3.3.3) and error prevention (3.3.4) do not apply there.

These are agent-assisted findings, not a certified Trusted Tester result.
